about: The heading of a reading from the Epistle of Saint Paul to the Ephesians. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Epistles of the Third Sunday of Lent, of the feast of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus and of several Sundays after Pentecost, among other Masses.

seg.tr: A reading from the Epistle of blessed Paul the Apostle to the Ephesians
